item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 11/Jan/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, the weather over southern China will be persistently fine and very dry today. It will still be cold over inland areas in the morning. A strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong later today to Monday. A dry northeast monsoon is expected to bring mainly fine weather to the coastal areas in the middle and latter parts of this week. It will be mild during the day over the region. Besides, an area of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to the seas east of the Philippines in the middle and latter parts of this week.
